ont.description: Path to BAM, CRAM or FASTQ.GZ files containing ONT reads (BAM/CRAM are converted to FASTQ)

illumina.description: Path to FASTQ.GZ files containing short reads. Paired-end files are recognized when ending with regex pattern '_(R?[12])(_[0-9][0-9][0-9])?.(fq|fastq).gz$'

long_limit.description: Limit the number input reads to this maximum total length (in bp), -1 to skip

short_limit.description: Limit the number input reads to this maximum total length (in bp), -1 to skip
